items.title: A Bad Day for Bank Stocks Is Killing the Dow
items.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average was trading lower thanks to bank stock weakness. The blue-chip index dropped 0.5%, or 232 points. Goldman Sachs and J.P. Morgan Chase were the two biggest stocks weighing on the Dow, contributing 105- and 75-point drags, respectively.

items.title: Inflation Pressures May Persist: ETFs Worth Watching Now
items.summary: From strong demand and AI spending to higher oil prices and war costs, multiple forces could keep inflation elevated for longer, putting ETFs in focus.

items.title: Will JPM's $20B QIA Partnership Strengthen Asset Management Business?
items.summary: JPMorgan's $20B QIA partnership spans public and private markets, expanding asset management capabilities and creating scope for longer-term fee-based growth.

items.title: What Does the Fed Rate Hike Mean for JPMorgan's Banking Business?
items.summary: JPM could see a modest NII rise from the Fed's 25-basis-point rate hike, though deposit costs, loan demand and credit quality remain key variables.

items.title: JPMorgan Plans to Double India Finance Hub Business in Two Years
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. seeks to double its GIFT City business over the next couple of years as the Wall Street bank steps up investment in India’s only international financial hub, according to Global Co-Head of Payments Max Neukirchen.

items.title: Goldman Eyes Nearly $70B Revenue Base in 2026: What's Driving Growth?
items.summary: GS targets a $70B revenue base in 2026 as GBM, AWM and efficiency gains drive growth and strengthen its earnings mix.

items.title: Fed Rate Hike: What it Means for Wells Fargo's NII Outlook
items.summary: Fed's latest rate hike could support WFC's NII expansion, but rising deposit costs and may limit the upside to some extent.
